final_action.public_message: Gemini, here’s a clean monopoly swap: New York completes your oranges, and I take the reds back plus $100 to balance Illinois being mortgaged. This creates a real counterweight to Claude’s pink machine.
final_action.private_thought: I need a monopoly to have any winning path. This gives Gemini orange, but leaves them cash-poor with Tennessee mortgaged; I’d regain reds plus enough cash to unmortgage/build selectively. If rejected, NY remains my key blocker.
